nodes.title: Test solver-rank interleave policy
nodes.change: Qualify outer and in-rank numactl behavior, then compare default versus in-rank policy in a 40-step ABBA solver trial.
nodes.result: Control A1 completed at 24.7586 s/step; candidate B1 timed out after 33 timings (partial mean 41.8465 s/step; not a score). Remaining arms did not start.
nodes.assessment: Close the all-rank interleave solver trial under this envelope. The two diagnostic jobs verified pre-exec rank policy behavior; the native candidate exceeded its frozen arm cap, so no complete comparison or performance promotion exists.
nodes.limitations: Policy and affinity proof covers pre-exec rank setup only, not policy or memory placement through OpenFOAM runtime. Candidate partial timings are not a full-run score. Force trajectories match only for a 34-row prefix; source-after and runtime-after gates were not reached. Pressure telemetry was unavailable. No capped-loser repeat is justified.

nodes.title: Test 48-rank Scotch at a matched horizon
nodes.change: Use a native 48-domain Scotch partition (job 2294914) and required initialization (2294915), then compare 48 versus 56 ranks in four 40-step ABBA arms (2294916). Rank count and required partition change together.
nodes.result: 2294918 BAAB: 48-rank mean 26.159176710 vs 56-rank mean 32.380543978 s/step (−19.213288300%); both adjacent pairs favor 48. Job 2294916 ABBA separately measured −17.382574569%.
nodes.assessment: Both complete, opposite-order 40-step allocations on iris001 pass all gates and favor 48 ranks. Together they support a qualified repeatable same-Iris 40-step configuration signal. This is not a full-simulation or universal result, and does not establish a matched win over teammate or organizer/BTC settings.
nodes.limitations: Only two allocations on the same physical node are reviewed; 48-rank repeat drift was +15.1737% in 2294916 and −9.99319% in 2294918. Rank count and required Scotch partition change together, so the causal mechanism and any hardware bottleneck remain unproven. Pressure telemetry was unavailable. This is Basic practice, not an official full-simulation score or cross-platform result.
